name: Lishenntser Lauros
original_name: リシュエンツェーリ・ラウロソ
source: She is the ruler of the Lauroso territory, which is located to the west of the Kingdom of Influss. She wishes to reunite with her former adventuring companions, but is concerned about fulfilling her responsibilities as the ruler. Upon learning that Avaro and the others are away on their honeymoon, she feels saddened that she cannot join them and promptly invites Kisnir, who is working as a knight, to accompany them. She is brave and daring, but also possesses the ability to assess situations calmly and take decisive action. Her upbringing has prepared her for leadership, and she is diligent in understanding and fulfilling the responsibilities that come with authority.
